title: Hot Wallet vs Cold Wallet: What's the Difference? (Crypto Beginner Guide)
caption: Educational only. Not financial advice. Hot vs cold wallets in plain English. Sources: Ledger, Ripple, QuickNode, MoonPay. AI-generated voice.

scenes.head: WHERE ARE YOUR COINS?
scenes.narration: Crypto is not stored in an app. So what actually holds it? The answer is your wallet.

scenes.head: HOT WALLET
scenes.narration: A hot wallet is connected to the internet. It is convenient, like cash in your pocket.

scenes.head: HOT WALLET RISK
scenes.narration: Being online also makes it a target for hackers and phishing, so many people keep small amounts there.

scenes.head: COLD WALLET
scenes.narration: A cold wallet keeps your private keys offline, often on a small device. That makes remote attacks much harder.

scenes.head: COLD WALLET RISK
scenes.narration: But if you lose it and your backup phrase, nobody can restore access. Never share that phrase with anyone.

scenes.head: BOTH HAVE TRADE OFFS
scenes.narration: Hot is easy but more exposed. Cold is safer but less handy. Many people use both.
